fx.usage: sound effect on resolution / impact of the effect

data.text: Choose an element: put lowest element token upside-down as penalty, then highest as permanent bonus.

logic.description: Implemented. Self only: one Vitality point-buy, the highest die lifts the caster SMALLEST stat and the smallest die dents its BIGGEST stat (same swap as Mutate on oneself). Under Aura the adjacent allies get the same treatment, under Aura ∀ everyone within 10. A failed roll re-emits.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
The recipient is the caster (no target, or the caster right-clicked itself).

effects.description: One point-buy on the caster stat of the first cast element: the highest die lifts the recipient SMALLEST stat (ties: vitality, world, will, matter order); on an enemy it is mirrored (−big on their biggest stat).
The smallest die of the same roll dents the recipient BIGGEST stat (enemy: +small on their smallest); 0 when the roll failed.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_vitality (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
